purpose: Rescue tier only. Used when a diagnostic lemma yields fewer than 5 occurrences from the primary tier. The primary tier (data/occurrences/pool.json) remains frozen and is never replaced.
eraPredicate: principal author DEATH year in 1900-1930, parsed from the catalog Authors life-date suffix. The catalog has no publication-year column; Issued is the ebook release date and cannot predate 1971.
license: Project Gutenberg License (works in the US public domain)

selectionRule.filter: Type == "Text" && Language == "en" && title not matching ^(Images|Music|Sound|Sheet Music|Cartons) && 1900 <= author death year <= 1930
selectionRule.bucket: first match in [fiction, science, philosophy, medicine, essays, reference, history]
selectionRule.sample: evenly spaced ranks round(k*(n-1)/(quota-1)) after sorting by author death year then Text#
